channels.im_read.description: Read the messages of one chat conversation (a group or a direct chat) in a time range, as context for the current task. You choose the conversation and the range. Read only: nothing is replied to, and no rule, flow or action runs. The result carries the conversation's disclosure level; follow it.
channels.im_read.arg.space: the conversation id (spc_…) or the exact name of a conversation you can see
channels.im_read.arg.from: start: unix ms, RFC 3339, or "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM" in the workspace's time zone; default 24 hours before to
channels.im_read.arg.to: end, in the same formats as from; default now
channels.im_read.arg.limit: at most this many messages, up to %{max} (default %{n})
channels.im_read.error.no_space_arg: Say which conversation to read: its id (spc_…) or exact name.
channels.im_read.error.no_space: No conversation "%{space}", or you cannot see it.
channels.im_read.error.which_space: "%{space}" matches more than one conversation or none exactly; use an id: %{candidates}
channels.im_read.error.not_readable: This conversation is set not to be used (blocked, or disclosure level never); it cannot be read.
channels.im_read.error.range: The time range is not valid: from must be before to.
channels.im_read.error.range_long: The time range is too long: at most %{days} days per read.

channels.text.bot_channel_note: The bot sends and receives messages in groups and direct chats
channels.text.bot_directory_note: Syncs departments and members to Contacts; member names need im:chat.members:read (group members) or contact:user.base:readonly (address book), the company name needs tenant:tenant:readonly
channels.text.send_as_user_note: Sends the replies you approve as you. Some Feishu organizations don't let members request this permission; without it Steve doesn't draft or reply for you, it only records, and asks you in Steve when needed
channels.text.user_channel_note: Reads your own direct and group messages; member names are looked up as you first (im:chat.members:read group members, contact:user.base:readonly address book)
channels.text.send_as_user_purpose: Send the replies you approve as you
channels.text.field_webhook_hint: Only needed to receive events by webhook; not with a long connection
channels.text.field_ext_url_hint: wss://…; plain ws:// only to 127.0.0.1 or ::1
channels.text.field_ext_pin_hint: For a self-signed certificate: sha256:<64 hex digits>
channels.text.ext_channel_note: Receives your messages through a channel service (WebSocket protocol)
channels.text.ext_send_note: Sends, replies, recalls and reacts as you
